# `gnss-sim`

Scenario kind of the engine v0.39.0, family [GNSS measurements, positioning and integrity](../gnss-measurements-positioning-and-integrity.md). Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service. Every label here is the engine's or the verification matrix's; a kind is MODELLED unless the matrix says otherwise (how a label is earned: the README's Evidence section).

## What it does

Measurement-domain pseudorange simulation (Klobuchar iono, Saastamoinen/Niell tropo) + RAIM.

One run of `scenarios/gnss-sim-raim.toml` summarises as: scenario ab854d9d7886 | gnss-sim | mean iono 19.9m tropo 6.8m | RAIM avail 0.82 mean HPL 22.2m VPL 39.9m fault-rate 0.000

## Inputs

From the schema (`kshana kinds --json`):

- Required fields: `seed`, `time`, `receiver`, `constellation`
- Optional fields: `iono`, `tropo`, `mask_deg`, `noise_sigma_m`, `multipath_m`, `sat_clock_rms_m`, `uere_m`, `p_fa`, `p_md`, `alert_limit_h_m`, `alert_limit_v_m`, `skyline`

The example `scenarios/gnss-sim-raim.toml` sets, among others:

| Field | Value | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `alert_limit_h_m` | 40 | m |
| `alert_limit_v_m` | 50 | m |
| `constellation.altitude_km` | 20200 | km |
| `constellation.inclination_deg` | 55 | deg |
| `constellation.phasing_f` | 1 | not stated |
| `constellation.planes` | 6 | not stated |
| `constellation.sats_per_plane` | 4 | not stated |
| `iono.alpha` | [3.8200e-8, 1.4900e-8, -1.7900e-7, 0] | not stated |
| `iono.beta` | [143000, 0, -328000, 113000] | not stated |
| `iono.gps_seconds_of_day` | 50400 | d |
| `kind` | gnss-sim | text |
| `mask_deg` | 5 | deg |

## Run it

```sh
kshana scenarios/gnss-sim-raim.toml
```

2 bundled scenarios use this kind; the others are in [`scenarios/`](../../../scenarios/).
